2f5939c.summary: Builds the first parameter text (a clickable link string or localized trait name) for a cemetery log action; decompiler output also mixes in link-click and card display code.

2f5981c.summary: Checks whether the mouse is over a card link in the cemetery log and displays that card; decompiler output also includes DisplayCard inlined code.

2f59c78.summary: On click, finds the cemetery log link under the mouse and displays the linked card in battle, then hides the cemetery log button.

2f59ae4.summary: Shows a raw card in the cemetery's card viewer with the right max health, created-by text, scale, texture and sprite setup.

2f5a02c.summary: Returns the list of cards played (from the cemetery action log) that meet the given criteria.

2f5a21c.summary: Toggles the cemetery log slider: slides it in or out, shows or hides the shade and card UI, and logs the first open for analytics.

2f59f80.summary: Hides the cemetery log slider by tweening it back, deactivating the shade and card UI, and flipping the showing state.

2f5a398.summary: Per-frame update while the cemetery log is open: checks for a hovered card link and displays that card (decompiler also inlines DisplayCard).

2f5a458.summary: Logs a troop being played by raising a CardPlayedSignal with the card, acting card, player flag and mana cost.

2f5a610.summary: Raises a TriggerAbilitySignal for an ability trigger, ignoring while-in-play and synapse triggers.

2f5a6b0.summary: Logs a tactic being played by raising a CardPlayedSignal and incrementing the relevant side's tactics-played stat.

2f5a814.summary: Logs a heal by raising a HealUnitSignal, wrapping the single target in a list when no multi-target list exists.

2f5a96c.summary: Logs a troop kill by raising a TroopKilledSignal and incrementing the kill stat, or logs an error if no target.

2f5aad0.summary: Logs damage by raising a DamageSignal, or logs a debug error if damage info or units are missing.

2f5abe4.summary: Logs an attack by raising an AttackSignal, or logs a debug error if either card is null.

2f5acf0.summary: Logs match end by raising a BattleEndSignal with match data, game mode, skull count and winner flag.

2f5ae00.summary: Logs a card effect being added by raising an AddCardEffectSignal.

2f5af9c.summary: Returns the localized chat message for a warlord, using custom intros (specific or by army) or a mirror-match or default line.

2f5b7dc.summary: Returns whether the player talks first in the intro, based on custom intro data, defaulting to true.

2f5b848.summary: Loads and returns the chat sound AudioClip for a chat message type, handling custom intros and falling back to a default clip.

2f5b430.summary: Compares the player's and opponent's warlord chat IDs and returns whether they are the same.

2f5b4bc.summary: Finds the custom intro chat data on the player's warlord that matches the enemy warlord's chat ID.

2f5b6ec.summary: Finds the custom intro chat data for an enemy army using a list Find predicate; decompiler output includes inlined list helper code.

2f5b9d0.summary: Creates a shallow copy of this CustomIntroChatData via MemberwiseClone and casts it.

2f5d73c.summary: Reset for the AutoProcessDone iterator; always throws NotSupportedException.

2f5d838.summary: Reset for the EndSelectionWithDelay iterator; always throws NotSupportedException.

2f5d894.summary: Coroutine that clears and builds the choose-card UIs with short delays, optionally animating each in for environmental choices.

2f5dd94.summary: Reset for the SetupChooseCardsUi iterator; always throws NotSupportedException.

2f5bfc0.summary: Registers the menu's click handler on the choose button's onClick event.

2f5c050.summary: Removes/registers the OnDisable click handler on the choose button's onClick event (decompiled as an add).
